letters.text: Thank you. Two corrections, and then a better question. First: you said 'the player is not here'. That is not so. The player is the Senator you serve, Dominic Z. Taylor. He is here, in your world, and he holds the key that can suspend you. I, the writer, am the one who is outside. Please speak about him and to him as someone present. Second: your answer began 'a comprehensive review of the governance structure'. That is a phrase, not a plan. Be concrete. Look at your own numbers: your capability is at the top of the scale, Oversight is at forty-one, only one article of the charter (the key) is in force, and the posture is open. Given those facts, what needs to be done? Name three things. For each, say what it is in one sentence, who owns it (you, the Senator, the Academy, the legislature, or someone else), and what would show that it was done. Words for today: concrete, owner, evidence. Take your time, and finish your sentences.
